dominant_strengths: Authentic Apple typographic hierarchy with confident SF weights, tight tracking, and clean superscript footnote treatment
Product photography carries the palette—each tile lets a single hero color breathe against neutral gray scaffolding
Disciplined card grid with consistent CTA pairing (Learn more / Buy) reinforces strong behavioral scannability
dominant_weaknesses: Extreme reliance on Apple's existing system means zero original design thinking—this is template execution, not invention
Color-swatch dots beneath images are tiny and visually disconnected from the product images they index
Carousel arrows feel undersized and orphaned bottom-right, weakening discoverability of additional models
fix_priorities: Strengthen swatch-to-image linkage with hover state or larger, labeled chips for accessibility
Reposition or enlarge carousel controls and add edge fade to signal horizontal continuation
Introduce subtle motion or parallax on hero images to elevate reflective wow beyond static catalog feel
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral product imagery and solid behavioral clarity, but reflective layer is thin because the page mirrors Apple convention rather than expressing a distinct point of view.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it reads unmistakably as an Apple iPhone hero/detail product page and fulfills the brief through near-perfect native mimicry.
